payload.claim: The same weak-inequality pattern recurs for block 2's "no-function" vs "no-ordinal" case labels. `test_bookkeeping_drafts_the_smoke_tests_paragraph_and_steps_its_ordinal` collects `no_function_cases` and `no_ordinal_cases` and only asserts `no_function_cases[0] != no_ordinal_cases[0]`, never that each message names its own case correctly. Swapping the `case == "no-function"` condition to `case == "no-ordinal"` on line 2333 makes every no-function scenario print the "docstring holds no ordinal" message and vice versa, yet the two sets stay internally consistent and mutually distinct, so the test still passes.
